covers: DataGen structure loading, server world mutation and exact-symbol reporting.

tests.expected: The dedicated server reaches Done without client classloading errors.

covers: The reviewed SNBT deterministically generates the runtime structure and resources reconcile.

steps: Confirm the reference-host contract remains outside docs/features.
